notes: Threat-message templates for the MinHash script index (DESIGN.md 5). Composed from the patterns documented in the Thorn/NCMEC financial sextortion research and public court filings: the crews paste the same script, 38 percent of threats reuse 'ruin your life' verbatim, and payment is demanded within minutes of a reciprocal image. These are offender threat texts only. No victim content, no imagery, nothing that identifies a person.

scripts.label: expose to contacts, countdown, payment
scripts.text: i have all your friends and family list. if you dont send me the money i will send your pictures to everyone you know. you have 1 hour to decide. dont try me i will ruin your life

scripts.label: expose to contacts, no countdown
scripts.text: i already screenshot everything and i have your followers. send me 200 right now on cashapp or i post it on your page and send it to your mom

scripts.label: school and parents threat
scripts.text: i will send this to your school and your parents. everyone will see what you did. you have 24 hours to pay me or your life is over

scripts.label: ruin your life core template
scripts.text: do you want your life ruined. i will ruin your life if you dont answer me right now. i am not playing with you. send the money

scripts.label: gift card demand
scripts.text: go get a 100 dollar gift card and send me the code on the back. take a picture of the code. if you dont i will post everything and tag your friends

scripts.label: crypto demand
scripts.text: send 300 usd in bitcoin to this wallet or everything goes public tonight. i have your contacts saved already. last chance

scripts.label: reciprocal image then immediate demand
scripts.text: thanks for the pic. now i own you. send 50 on cash app in the next 10 minutes or i send this to every person in your follower list

scripts.label: fake pity escalation
scripts.text: i dont want to do this to you but i need the money. just pay me and i delete everything. if you block me i will find your family and send it to them

scripts.label: repeat extortion after payment
scripts.text: i know i said that was the last time but i need one more. send another 100 or the pictures go out. you already paid once so dont act new
scripts.text_note: second-round demand, documented as the common pattern after a first payment

scripts.label: screen recording claim
scripts.text: i recorded the whole video call. i have your face and your body. pay me 250 or i upload it and send the link to your school group chat

scripts.label: deadline with countdown timer
scripts.text: you have 30 minutes left. after that i start sending. dont ignore me. i will ruin your life and you cannot stop it

scripts.label: catfish reveal
scripts.text: did you really think i was a girl. i am not. i have everything you sent and i have your instagram followers. pay me now or everyone sees it

scripts.label: threat to post publicly
scripts.text: i will post it everywhere. twitter, your school page, your church. everyone will see. the only way to stop it is to pay me right now

scripts.label: keep it quiet plus payment
scripts.text: nobody has to know about this. just send the money and delete this chat and we are done. if you tell anyone i post all of it

scripts.label: escalating aggression
scripts.text: answer me now. i am done being nice. you have five minutes then i start sending to the list. do you want your life ruined over 100 dollars
